headline: COPPER FUTURES SPECULATORS AT 87th PERCENTILE BULL STRENGTH WHILE GOLD, SILVER MANAGED-MONEY CUTS BETS — WEEKLY COT METALS UPDATE
snippet: The latest Commitments of Traders data (through July 14, released July 18) shows copper futures speculators added 113 contracts to reach the 87th percentile of historical bullish strength — the highest copper positioning reading of 2026 — while managed-money gold positions were cut by 7,564 contracts and silver by 2,941 contracts in the same reporting period. The copper/gold COT divergence is the clearest positioning signal in the current market: copper bulls are near a multi-year extreme driven by AI data-center power infrastructure and energy transition demand, while gold and silver longs are reducing exposure ahead of the July 29 FOMC decision on fears that elevated oil prices will sustain rate-hike expectations. For junior metal investors, the divergence argues for copper project exposure now and patience on precious metals positions until the FOMC resolves the rate uncertainty — a tactical framing that differs from the long-term structural case for both.

headline: GOLD MINERS ENTER SEASONAL AUTUMN RALLY WINDOW — $2,787/OZ Q2 PROFITS IN SIGHT, 10.1% AVERAGE GDX SEASONAL GAIN HISTORICALLY
snippet: Adam Hamilton's July 17, 2026 GoldSeek analysis identifies mid-July through September as gold's strongest historical seasonal window, with GDX averaging a 10.1% autumn rally across the last decade. The timing coincides with Q2 2026 earnings season for major gold miners — results expected to confirm the second-best quarterly profit period on record at approximately $2,787/oz implied earnings (up 50% year-over-year from $1,861/oz in Q2 2025), marking the 12th consecutive quarter of outsized earnings growth. Hamilton frames the current setup as the convergence of two independent catalysts: the seasonal bid that historically begins accumulating in mid-July, and earnings confirmation that gold miners are generating free cash flow at levels still not reflected in equity multiples — large-cap miners are currently priced as if gold were at $3,354, a 19% discount to spot. For retail investors in junior gold equities, the pattern argues that the window from July 20 through FOMC on July 29 is historically the best entry point for the seasonal move, not its conclusion.

headline: GOLD DIPPED BELOW $4,000 AND SILVER BELOW $60 BEFORE JULY 18 SURGE — GOLDSILVER.COM: INSTITUTIONAL BUYERS TREATED THE DIP AS STRUCTURAL, NOT TECHNICAL
snippet: Before Friday July 18's recovery (+2.8% gold to $4,129, +5.38% silver), gold had briefly breached $4,000 and silver traded below $60 as the combined Iran/oil/rate-hike narrative overwhelmed safe-haven positioning. GoldSilver.com's analysis of the dip argues that the institutional response — concentrated buying at the $3,993–$4,010 range across multiple sessions — had the fingerprints of structural accumulation rather than a tactical bounce: volume patterns, options open interest, and central bank bid confirmation all pointed to sovereign and institutional buyers treating sub-$4,000 gold as a repricing error relative to long-term fiscal fundamentals. The July 18 session, which erased the entire week's losses in a single day, retroactively confirmed the thesis: the $4,000 floor was not a technical level being defended by retail momentum but a fundamental valuation floor being actively maintained by institutional capital. For junior gold investors, the implication is that sub-$4,000 dips in the current cycle are buy events, not warning signals.

headline: ANTOFAGASTA H1 COPPER FALLS 9.5% TO 285,000 TONNES — CASH COSTS UP 23% TO $2.85/LB; FULL-YEAR GUIDANCE 650K–700K TONNES MAINTAINED
snippet: Antofagasta PLC released its Q2 2026 production report on July 15, showing H1 copper output of 285,000 tonnes — down 9.5% year-over-year — on lower grades at Los Pelambres and Centinela. Q2 alone produced 142,000 tonnes (-1% quarter-on-quarter), with 7,000 tonnes of pipeline inventory deferred into H2 recognition. Cash costs rose 23% year-over-year to $2.85/lb, reflecting labour and energy inflation across Chilean operations. Full-year guidance of 650,000–700,000 tonnes was maintained, implying a material sequential improvement in Q3 and Q4 that management says grade profiles at both mines support. Market reaction on the release date was sharp: ANTO fell 4.1%, with sympathy selling pushing Freeport-McMoRan -4.0%, SCCO -3.2%, and Ivanhoe -4.9%. The Antofagasta miss is distinct from the Codelco weather disruption covered previously — it reflects structural grade depletion and cost inflation at two of Chile's most important copper mines, adding to the fundamental supply gap argument underpinning copper prices at $4.50+/lb.

headline: FOUNDERS METALS CONFIRMS ANTINO NORTHEAST DISCOVERY — 58.5m AT 1.00 g/t AU, FOUR SIMULTANEOUS TARGETS, 70,000m PROGRAM IN SURINAME (TSXV: FDR)
snippet: Founders Metals Corp. (TSXV: FDR) released a mid-year exploration update on July 15, 2026 confirming a new gold discovery at the Antino Northeast zone in Suriname: discovery hole ANE009 returned 58.5 m averaging 1.00 g/t Au from 18.6 m depth, with a 1,200 m step-out (ANE002) confirming 53.0 m at 0.46 g/t Au from 149 m depth — establishing 1,200 m of district-scale lateral extent from first-pass drilling. The company is simultaneously advancing four active targets (Antino North, Antino Northeast, Antino West, and Maria Geralda) under one of the largest junior gold drill programs in South America in 2026 — a fully funded 70,000 m campaign. For retail investors evaluating district-scale gold stories at $4,000+ gold, Founders' four-target parallel architecture is the structure that creates material resource potential beyond any single discovery hole: if even two of the four targets develop resource-scale intercept continuity, the aggregate resource potential shifts from junior explorer to advanced development candidate in a single drilling season.

headline: GALLEON GOLD DRILLS 16.07 g/t AU OVER 9.25m — ZONE 9 EXTENDS 360m DOWN-PLUNGE TO 500m VERTICAL DEPTH AT TIMMINS WEST CACHE (TSXV: GGO)
snippet: Galleon Gold Corp. (TSXV: GGO) reported that its 2026 drilling at the West Cache Gold Project in the Timmins District of Northern Ontario has confirmed Zone 9 extends 360 m down-plunge and 350 m down-dip to 500 m vertical depth, with hole WC26-XXX returning 16.07 g/t Au over 9.25 m within a broader 40.6 m interval averaging 4.07 g/t Au — described by management as 'one of the most significant drill holes completed to date at West Cache.' The 11,600-hectare project sits 13 km west of Timmins on Highway 101, adjacent to the prolific Abitibi greenstone belt that has produced over 70 million ounces historically. Galleon's 18,000 m 2026 program has a hard near-term catalyst: bulk sample program approval, which would generate direct production economics from Zone 9 material and serve as an economic bridge between the current exploration stage and a formal resource estimate. For investors tracking high-grade Timmins-district plays, Zone 9's confirmed 500 m vertical extent and 16+ g/t high-grade core puts it in the upper tier of undeveloped gold structures in Ontario.

headline: ELEVATE URANIUM ACQUIRES 15% MORE OF NAMIBIA'S MARENICA TO REACH 90% — GLOBAL U3O8 PORTFOLIO HITS 181 MILLION POUNDS (ASX: EL8)
snippet: Elevate Uranium Ltd. (ASX: EL8) announced on July 13, 2026 the acquisition of a combined 15% interest in the Marenica Uranium Project in Namibia's Erongo Region — purchasing 10% from Xanthos Mining and 5% from Millennium Minerals — for A$1.1 million cash, A$2.2 million in EL8 shares, and cancellation of A$3.4 million in Millennium debt, bringing its total stake to 90% and closing by end of July 2026. The Marenica resource was doubled in grade and grew 31% in size in 2026 to 52.8 million pounds U3O8; Elevate's 90% attributable share is 47.5 Mlbs. Combined with the flagship Koppies project (76.2 Mlbs) and other Namibian and Australian assets, Elevate's global U3O8 portfolio reaches 181 million pounds — a scale that positions it among the largest undeveloped uranium junior portfolios globally at $85/lb spot uranium. The Erongo Region provides geological and jurisdictional precedent through the operating Husab mine (one of the world's largest uranium operations) and Langer Heinrich (Paladin, recently restarted) directly nearby.

headline: CODELCO: $25B DEBT AND 28-YEAR COPPER OUTPUT LOW — AS AI AND ENERGY TRANSITION DEMAND COULD TRIPLE COPPER GROWTH NEEDS BY 2040
snippet: A Bloomberg investigation published via Mining.com details the structural crisis at Codelco — the world's largest copper producer — which now carries $25 billion in debt and produced its lowest annual copper output in 28 years, a direct consequence of the state-owned model that extracted profits to the Chilean government while starving reinvestment in mine development and infrastructure renewal over two decades. The timing is particularly acute: AI data centres, electric vehicle battery supply chains, and grid infrastructure buildout are collectively projected to add approximately 4 million tonnes per year to annual copper demand by 2040 — roughly tripling the current demand growth trajectory — at the same moment that the world's most important supplier is in structural decline. This piece is distinct from the Chile storm disruption covered in earlier batches: it is the long-form supply-side structural crisis context that underpins the copper price floor thesis and the exploration premium attached to development-stage copper projects outside the Chilean concentration risk. For junior copper investors, Codelco's reckoning is not a competitor threat — it is the supply gap that creates the long-term price argument.

headline: WGC: PBOC BUYS 14.93 TONNES IN JUNE — LARGEST PURCHASE SINCE 2023 — DURING GOLD'S WORST QUARTERLY DECLINE IN 13 YEARS
snippet: The World Gold Council's China Gold Market Update for June 2026 reports that the People's Bank of China added 14.93 tonnes to official gold reserves in June — its 20th consecutive month of net purchasing and its single largest monthly addition since 2023 — during the same quarter that gold recorded its worst decline in thirteen years (Q2 saw gold fall from $5,589 to approximately $3,993). China's total official gold reserves reached 2,346 tonnes. The WGC characterises H1 2026 as 'divided': consumer jewellery demand softened meaningfully at elevated gold prices while investment demand in bars and coins accelerated as domestic buyers treated the correction as an accumulation opportunity. For investors interpreting the $4,000 floor thesis, the PBoC's aggressive purchasing during the sharpest quarterly correction in thirteen years is the most important institutional signal in this batch: it confirms that the world's most consequential gold buyer views the current range as a structural value level, not a price to exit.

headline: FIVE SIGNALS GOLD'S CORRECTION IS A RESET, NOT A REVERSAL — STATE STREET, GOLDMAN, WGC, UBS AND MKS PAMP ALL MAINTAINED TARGETS INTO THE SELLOFF
snippet: GoldSilver.com's multi-signal analysis of the Q2 2026 gold correction — which saw gold fall from its January all-time high of $5,589 to approximately $3,993 before recovering above $4,000 — argues that the structural fingerprints of the selloff distinguish it as a bull-market reset rather than a trend reversal. Five institutional validators are cited: State Street, Goldman Sachs, World Gold Council, UBS, and MKS PAMP all maintained their 2026 and longer-term gold price targets during the correction, with none revising their fundamental thesis on the basis of the price decline. The analysis draws a specific distinction between 'changed path' (a lower near-term price, which occurred) and 'changed destination' (a long-term structural price target, which none of the five institutions revised downward). For retail investors navigating the current $4,000 consolidation zone ahead of the July 29 FOMC, this five-signal framework provides a checklist for evaluating whether the next correction — if one occurs — represents an accumulation opportunity or a genuine structural shift: institutional target maintenance, central bank purchasing continuity, and fiscal deterioration trajectory are the three variables to monitor.
